summary: The six-story building at 1515 Third Street, the second building of the Uber headquarters campus designed by SHoP Architects (per ArchDaily) and developed by a joint venture of Alexandria Real Estate Equities and Uber formed in September 2014; the Assessor roll gives 6 stories, 302,084 sq ft and 2021 as year built, the Department of Building Inspection shows its new-construction permit completed on 2021-04-01, and OpenAI leases it with 1455 Third Street (Uber, October 2023).

milestones.text: Alexandria Real Estate Equities and Uber form a joint venture and acquire the 1455/1515 Third Street land parcels for ground-up development of two Class A buildings (422,980 rentable sq ft together)
Department of Building Inspection new-construction permit application 201508245062 filed to erect a 7-story, type 1 office and retail building at 1515 3rd St (estimated cost $57,684,393)
SocketSite reports pile drivers arriving and permit paperwork filed to start driving piles for Uber's headquarters
Permit 201606039047 for installation of 268 new piles and 14 existing precast piles issued
Department of Building Inspection records new-construction permit 201508245062 as complete (completed date 2021-04-01); the Assessor roll lists 2021 as year built
An Uber spokesperson confirms OpenAI is leasing two buildings from Uber's Mission Bay headquarters, 1455 and 1515 Third St

costs.what: Estimated cost stated on new-construction permit 201508245062 (self-reported for the permit fee)

facts.value: Joint venture of Alexandria Real Estate Equities (51%) and Uber Technologies (49%), formed September 2014, per Alexandria's 3Q14 report
SHoP Architects (ArchDaily lists the project year as 2022)
6 on the Assessor roll and in ArchDaily ('a six-story structure at 1515 Third Street'); the permit proposed 7 stories
302,084 (Assessor roll property_area); 422,980 rentable sq ft for 1455 and 1515 Third Street together (Alexandria, 2014)
$125.0 million purchase price for both parcels (1455/1515 Third Street) including 423 parking structure spaces, foundation piles, plans and permits; not split by building
OpenAI leases 1455 and 1515 Third St from Uber (October 2023)
